text.tspan: God Made You, God Made Me
Thank Him, thank Him, all the little children;
God loves you, God loves me!
Thank Him, thank Him, all the little children;
God loves you, God loves me!
Thank Him, thank Him, all the little children;
God bless you, God bless me!
Thank Him, thank Him, all the little children;
God bless you, God bless me!
